summary: Iter84 MECHANISM test of the one-file brand rename (frontend-next/lib/brand.config.js line 24). Flipped NAME='MechTest' -> yarn build (55s, exit 0) -> restarted frontend -> curled 20 routes: ZERO exact-case 'Addrika' on all routes except /blog (10 hits, come from DB blog post copy, not code) and multiple 'MechTest' hits on every route (/ 56, /faq 205, /about-us 43, /our-story 49, /why-choose-addrika 91). Reverted to NAME='Addrika', rebuilt (exit 0), restarted; 'Addrika' back (/ 62, /faq 205) and ZERO 'MechTest' anywhere. brand.config.js is left at NAME='Addrika' (idempotency requirement satisfied). Playwright smoke on / and /faq confirms visible brand + SEO title driven by BRAND.name and no MechTest residue. Backend regression: /api/products returns 9 products including id=bilvapatra-fragrance name='Belpatra'; /api/products/bambooless-dhoop-8inch -> 404. HOWEVER pytest test_iter82_product_cleanup.py has 3 persistent FAILURES on the Supabase products_mirror (bambooless row still present, price_inr/stock_pieces NULL on 9 b2c rows) - a real regression of iter79/80/82 guarantees, unrelated to the brand refactor.

critical.issue: Row id='bambooless-dhoop-8inch' name='8" Bambooless Dhoop' still exists in products_mirror (updated_at 2026-08-19T10:10Z) although the product was deleted from MongoDB and /api/products. test_iter82::test_no_bambooless_mirror_rows and ::test_b2c_mirror_rows FAIL. Cascade delete to the mirror is not happening (or a re-sync re-inserts the deleted SKU).

9 of 10 b2c mirror rows have price_inr=NULL AND stock_pieces=NULL (regal-rose, yemeni-bakhoor-chips, bold-bakhoor, mystical-meharishi, grated-omani-bakhoor, kesar-chandan, oriental-oudh, royal-kewda, bambooless-dhoop-8inch); only bilvapatra-fragrance is hydrated (110.00/0). Breaks test_iter82::test_regression_price_and_stock_hydrated and test_iter80_cascade_delete::test_active_b2c_rows_have_price_and_stock. iter79/80 hydration fix has regressed.

minor.issue: Running test_iter82_product_cleanup.py together with test_iter80_cascade_delete.py produces 2 extra transient failures (test_no_orphan_b2b_mirror_rows -> mogra-magic-b2b/mogra-magic-200-b2b, test_no_stale_bilvapatra_name_in_mirror). Both pass when iter82 runs alone => iter80's fixture data leaks into iter82 mirror assertions (test isolation issue, not product bug).
All 16 b2b mirror rows have price_inr=NULL (stock_pieces=0). Not asserted by current tests but likely unintended.

critical_code_review_comments: brand.config.js correctly centralises name/logo/copy, but the rename is only complete for exact-case 'Addrika'. Case-variant ('ADDRIKA') and slug/handle variants ('addrika.fragrances', 'addrika_incense', keyword list) are still hardcoded - add BRAND.nameUpper and BRAND.social.instagram and a CI grep guard (case-insensitive) to keep the invariant.
Rename requires a full `yarn build` because pages are statically prerendered - document this in brand.config.js header so a future operator does not just restart the server.

Mirror sync appears to be write-only for name fields; price/stock hydration and delete propagation are not covered by the sync path - add an integration test in backend that asserts mirror parity right after product create/update/delete.
